jobs.title: Strategic Litigation Team Manager
jobs.reason: A Manager-level role (Project/Regional Leads/Managers pay band) that is clearly not entry-level, and a strategic-litigation lead almost certainly requires legal qualification and substantial experience the candidate lacks. The human-rights mission is a perfect interest match, but the level and likely legal-qualification requirement are hard blockers.

jobs.title: Fundraising Coordinator
jobs.reason: This is an entry-level Coordinator role the candidate could hold, but it is a fundraising function that sits outside the candidate's research/analysis strengths and dedicated fundraising experience is a gap. The human-rights organisation is a strong interest draw, but the job content is administrative fundraising rather than the policy/research work the candidate is aiming for.
jobs.salary: £32,696 per annum plus up to 5% matched pension

jobs.title: Director
jobs.reason: This is a top executive Director role leading an organisation through a senior team of three Deputy Directors — far beyond entry-level and a hard mismatch for a candidate with no full-time professional experience. The advocacy field is adjacent to the candidate's interests, but the seniority is a disqualifier.

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for experts to join an advisory committee, not a paid entry-level role — it seeks established experts on climate-justice securitisation and defender criminalisation, an experience level the candidate does not have, and it is an advisory/voluntary appointment rather than a genuine paid vacancy. The human-rights/security field is on-interest, but the level and role type are hard mismatches.

jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for established experts to join an advisory committee, not a paid entry-level role — it seeks seasoned specialists with standing in the field, which the candidate (a current MSc student with RA experience only) does not have, and it reads as an unpaid advisory position. Although the human-rights and securitisation subject matter is genuinely close to the candidate's interests, the seniority/expert requirement and non-role nature are hard blockers.

jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member – Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for expert advisory committee members — a voluntary/advisory role seeking established experts and activists, not a paid entry-level position, and it appears aimed at defenders with lived experience from East Africa, Latin America and Southeast Asia. It is not a genuine paid vacancy the candidate could take, so it fails the paid-role gate despite the strong human-rights subject matter.
